name: com.prizepicksapi/server
title: PrizePicks API
description: Live PrizePicks prop lines, goblin/demon tiers, line history, graded results, sportsbook comparison.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional for public search/fetch; supply Bearer followed by your API key for authenticated data tools.

environmentVariables.name: PRIZEPICKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Free key at https://prizepicksapi.com/sign-up. Without it only the keyless demo, payout-table and credit-cost tools are listed.
